newsitem.title: USA: Plasma-Therm president on medical leave.
newsitem.headline: Plasma-Therm president on medical leave.

text.p: Plasma-Therm Inc said president and chief operating officer Scott Deferrari was taking a medical leave of absence for about 60 to 90 days effective on Friday.

The company said in a statement that during his leave, Ronald H. Deferrari, the chief executive and chairman, would serve as acting president. Curt Barratt, the vice president and chief technical officer will serve as acting chief operating officer.
The statement said the company's "experienced core management team will assure smooth operations during Mr. Deferrari's absence."
Further details were not immediately available.
